clauses.scope_note: Bailian Service Agreement §4.3.2; use of a user-created custom plugin.
clauses.condition_explanation: custom_plugin_use means using the service’s custom-plugin capability. The user must independently ensure the plugin’s availability, security, and compliance; losses caused to Alibaba Cloud or its affiliates must be compensated.

obligation_items.content: Ensure the custom plugin’s availability, security, and compliance.
obligation_items.object: licensee-created custom plugin
obligation_items.trigger: When using a custom plugin through the service.

obligation_items.content: Compensate Alibaba Cloud or its affiliates for losses caused by the custom plugin.
obligation_items.object: losses caused by the custom plugin
obligation_items.trigger: When the custom plugin causes a loss to Alibaba Cloud or an affiliate.

clauses.scope_note: Bailian Service Agreement §4.3.3; applies when the licensee develops an application or provides a service using the platform, as a technical supporter or service provider.
clauses.condition_explanation: licensee_develops_or_provides_external_application_or_service means the licensee uses the service to develop an application or provide services to others. The cited national laws and regulations are identified in the source; their detailed requirements are not independently supplied here.

obligation_items.content: Comply with the laws and regulations applicable to the application or service provided using the platform.
obligation_items.actor: licensee acting as technical supporter or service provider
obligation_items.object: licensee’s application or service
obligation_items.trigger: When the licensee develops an application or provides services to others using the service.

obligation_items.content: Ensure training-data sources are lawful and do not infringe intellectual-property or personal-information rights; take or commission effective measures to improve training-data authenticity, accuracy, objectivity, and diversity.
obligation_items.object: training data supplied to Alibaba Cloud
obligation_items.trigger: When the licensee trains a model and supplies training data.

obligation_items.content: If labeling data itself, establish clear, specific, workable labeling rules; assess labeling quality and sample-check accuracy; train labeling personnel as necessary; and supervise and guide them to label lawfully.
obligation_items.object: data-labeling work and personnel
obligation_items.trigger: When the licensee itself labels training data.

obligation_items.content: Collect users’ nonessential personal information, unlawfully retain input information or usage records capable of identifying users, or unlawfully provide such information or records to others.
obligation_items.object: users’ personal information, input information, and usage records
obligation_items.trigger: When the licensee provides an external service using the platform.

obligation_items.content: Clearly disclose the service’s applicable users, scenarios, and purposes, and guide users to understand and use the service rationally and lawfully.
obligation_items.object: licensee’s external service and information provided to its users
obligation_items.trigger: When the licensee provides an external service using the platform.

obligation_items.content: Conduct the legally required security assessment and applicable filing or registration.
obligation_items.object: licensee’s service
obligation_items.trigger: When the service has public-opinion attributes or social-mobilization capability.

obligation_items.content: Retain application- and service-related logs, including information generated or edited by users through the application or service, as required by law.
obligation_items.object: application and service logs
obligation_items.trigger: When the licensee provides an application or service using the platform.

clauses.scope_note: Bailian Service Agreement §4.3.5; cooperation duty arising from an infringement complaint, report, claim, or lawsuit caused by the licensee’s breach.
clauses.condition_explanation: ip_ownership_challenge_or_complaint means a third party challenges or complains about intellectual-property ownership concerning materials used with the service, or the service’s intellectual property. The paragraph also imposes loss allocation and indemnification; those remedies are not a separate license activity.

obligation_items.content: Take active measures, including providing evidence and participating in litigation as applicable, to help Alibaba Cloud and its partners avoid or promptly resolve the complaint, report, claim, or lawsuit.
obligation_items.object: the relevant infringement complaint, report, claim, or lawsuit
obligation_items.trigger: When the licensee’s use in breach of the agreement infringes third-party rights and causes a complaint, report, claim, or lawsuit against Alibaba Cloud or its partners.

clauses.scope_note: Bailian Service Agreement §4.4; third-party model or technology accessed through Bailian.
clauses.condition_explanation: third_party_model_or_technology_used_through_bailian means the licensee uses a third-party-provided model or technical service through Bailian. Compliance with the applicable third-party usage requirements, including open-source license terms, is required; the source does not supply those terms here.

obligation_items.content: Comply with the applicable third-party usage requirements or rules, including applicable open-source license terms.
obligation_items.object: third-party model or technical service used through Bailian
obligation_items.trigger: When using a third-party model or technical service through Bailian.

clauses.scope_note: Bailian Service Agreement §4.6; the service and platform models, including model output for the competitive-product restriction.
clauses.condition_explanation: written_permission_from_alibaba_cloud_and_relevant_rightsholders means written permission from both Alibaba Cloud and the relevant rights holders. The restriction against resale applies to the service and platform models. The competitive-product restriction separately covers using the service or platform models, including output, to train or develop products or services competing with those offered by the provider or its affiliates.

obligation_items.content: Resell the service or a model within the platform.
obligation_items.object: Bailian service or a platform model
obligation_items.trigger: Unless Alibaba Cloud and the relevant rights holders have given written permission.

clauses.scope_note: Bailian Service Agreement §4.6; competitive-product restriction includes model output but does not make output a derivative of the model.
clauses.condition_explanation: written_permission_from_alibaba_cloud_and_relevant_rightsholders means written permission from both Alibaba Cloud and the relevant rights holders. Competing products or services are those competing with the service or models offered by Alibaba Cloud or its affiliates.

obligation_items.content: Use the service, a platform model, or model output to train or develop a product or service that competes with the service or models offered by Alibaba Cloud or its affiliates.
obligation_items.object: the service, a platform model, or its output
obligation_items.trigger: Unless Alibaba Cloud and the relevant rights holders have given written permission.

clauses.scope_note: Bailian Service Agreement §§5.1.1.1–5.1.1.2; commercial closed-source and open-source third-party marketplace models or technical services have distinct requirements.
clauses.condition_explanation: third_party_model_or_technology_selected means the licensee selects a model or technical service developed and supplied by a third party. For a commercial closed-source service, the licensee must review and agree to the provider’s online agreement and usage rules before use. For an open-source model or service, the applicable open-source license may govern; the platform’s displayed license may not be current or accurate, so the licensee must independently find and confirm the latest applicable terms before use. This clause does not supply or infer the contents of those third-party terms.

obligation_items.content: Before starting use, review and agree to all terms of the third-party provider’s online agreement and service usage rules.
obligation_items.object: third-party commercial closed-source model or technical service
obligation_items.trigger: When selecting a third-party commercial closed-source model or technical service.

obligation_items.content: Before starting use, independently locate and confirm the latest applicable open-source license terms.
obligation_items.object: third-party open-source model or technical service
obligation_items.trigger: When selecting a third-party open-source model or technical service.

clauses.scope_note: Bailian Service Agreement §5.2.1; Token Plan and Coding Plan subscription products.
clauses.condition_explanation: token_plan_or_coding_plan_subscription_use means using a Token Plan or Coding Plan subscription. Product-specific billing standards and supported-model lists are determined by the product page at the time of use; this clause does not fabricate their values.

obligation_items.content: Read and comply with the applicable Token Plan or Coding Plan product documentation, including its usage instructions and details.
obligation_items.object: applicable subscription product documentation
obligation_items.trigger: When using a Token Plan or Coding Plan subscription.

clauses.scope_note: Bailian Service Agreement §5.2.2; Token Plan personal edition (not team edition) and/or Coding Plan. Provider’s authorized storage and use of calling inputs and model outputs for service improvement and model optimization is stated as an authorization, not a licensee obligation.
clauses.condition_explanation: token_plan_personal_or_coding_plan_model_calls means model calls made during use of the Token Plan personal edition, excluding the team edition, and/or Coding Plan. The authorization may be ended prospectively by stopping use; ending it does not cover content and data already authorized for use.

clauses.scope_note: Bailian Service Agreement §5.2.3; Token Plan team edition SSO account and API Key.
clauses.condition_explanation: token_plan_team_sso_or_api_key_use means use of the Token Plan team edition’s SSO login or API Key. The enterprise registered to the corresponding Alibaba Cloud account is responsible for identity authentication.

obligation_items.content: Ensure the SSO account and API Key credentials are kept secure.
obligation_items.actor: licensee or the enterprise it represents
obligation_items.object: Token Plan team edition SSO account and API Key credentials
obligation_items.trigger: When using the Token Plan team edition.

clauses.scope_note: Bailian Service Agreement §5.3.1.1; third-party model API service from Alibaba Cloud Marketplace.
clauses.condition_explanation: third_party_model_api_service_selected means selecting a third-party model API service. Use signifies agreement to the corresponding third-party service agreement. If the licensee does not agree to any term, the agreement expressly requires stopping use. The referenced agreement list is not supplied in this source.

obligation_items.content: Stop using the selected third-party model API service if the licensee does not agree to any term of its applicable third-party service agreement.
obligation_items.object: selected third-party model API service
obligation_items.trigger: When the licensee does not agree to any term of the applicable third-party agreement.

clauses.scope_note: Bailian Service Agreement §5.3.1.2; first call through Bailian to a third-party model API service from Alibaba Cloud Marketplace. The provider’s role creation and information sharing are not duties owed by the licensee.
clauses.condition_explanation: first_marketplace_third_party_api_call means the first call by the licensee through Bailian to a Marketplace third-party model API service. The licensee authorizes role creation and use for querying Marketplace product information and calling the service; the provider may share information about the licensee’s use with the third-party API provider.

clauses.scope_note: Bailian Service Agreement §6.1.2; customer information provided to or needed by the provider to supply the service. Provider collection and use purposes, rather than user-facing obligations, are described here.
clauses.condition_explanation: customer_information_processing_for_service means processing customer information for the purposes listed in §6.1.2, including account registration and necessary account information, support and service improvement, optional customer research or communications, service necessity, or legal and regulatory requirements. The separate opt-out for research and commercial electronic messages is set out below.

clauses.scope_note: Bailian Service Agreement §6.1.2(3); optional customer-experience research, service communications, or commercial electronic messages.
clauses.condition_explanation: research_contact_or_commercial_electronic_messages means the provider contacts the customer for research or service communications, or sends commercial electronic information. The source allows the customer to decline research or communications by stating that preference, unsubscribing by email, or declining a questionnaire, and to unsubscribe from commercial electronic messages using the indicated method.

clauses.scope_note: Bailian Service Agreement §§6.2.1–6.2.2; customer business data uploaded, stored, processed, downloaded, distributed, or otherwise handled through the service.
clauses.condition_explanation: customer_business_data_processed_through_service means data handled through the service. The customer retains control. The user must ensure the data lawfully originates from resources it owns and that it has the relevant rights, including control, intellectual-property, disposition, and licensing rights; personal-information processing must be lawful and sufficiently authorized, including entrusting processing to the provider.

obligation_items.content: Ensure customer business data lawfully originates from data resources the licensee owns and that the licensee holds the required rights in the data, including control, intellectual-property, disposition, and licensing rights.
obligation_items.object: customer business data
obligation_items.trigger: When providing or processing customer business data through the service.

obligation_items.content: Ensure collection and use of personal information in customer business data comply with law and that the data subject has sufficiently authorized that collection, use, and entrusting of processing to the provider.
obligation_items.object: personal information in customer business data
obligation_items.trigger: When customer business data contains personal information.

clauses.scope_note: Bailian Service Agreement §§6.2.3–6.2.5; provider-side limitations on processing customer business data, with a corresponding prohibition on unauthorized model training.
clauses.condition_explanation: customer_business_data_processed_by_provider means customer business data is processed by the provider or its authorized partner. Processing is limited to documented customer instructions and legally required or authority-directed processing. The agreement states that the provider will not use conversation data to train its models without authorization.

clauses.scope_note: Bailian Service Agreement §6.2.4; customer business data and provider-held copies, including backup-system information subject to stated technical and legal limitations.
clauses.condition_explanation: customer_requests_deletion_or_change means the customer chooses to delete or change its data. The provider states it will act on the customer’s instruction; deletion may not immediately reach backups, which must be stored securely and further processing restricted until deletion is possible. Deleted data cannot be recovered.

clauses.scope_note: Bailian Service Agreement §6.2.8; customer business data processed at a selected Bailian service and model-service location outside mainland China.
clauses.condition_explanation: customer_selects_overseas_processing means the customer selects processing outside mainland China for its own business purpose. Potential data export requires the customer, as controller, to fulfill applicable outbound-data compliance obligations.

obligation_items.content: Fulfill applicable data-export compliance obligations, including obtaining necessary authorization and consent, making required disclosures and declarations, and entering agreements with overseas recipients.
obligation_items.actor: licensee as controller of customer business data
obligation_items.object: customer business data selected for processing outside mainland China
obligation_items.trigger: When the customer selects such overseas processing and it may result in data being exported.

clauses.scope_note: Bailian Service Agreement §6.2.9; data processing and deployment mode for a third-party model API service.
clauses.condition_explanation: third_party_model_api_service_selected means selecting a third-party model API service under §5.3. The applicable third-party service agreement governs its data processing, including storage, deletion, and content-safety filtering, and its deployment mode, including service-access and inference locations. The third-party agreement is not supplied here.

clauses.scope_note: Bailian Service Agreement §7.1; the Bailian service itself. The sentence also states that pre-existing intellectual property remains with its respective party and permits provider storage and use of supplied information content for service purposes; those statements are not additional licensee grants.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibited conduct is reverse engineering, reverse assembly, reverse compilation, or otherwise attempting to discover the service’s source code.

obligation_items.content: Reverse engineer, reverse assemble, reverse compile, or otherwise attempt to discover the service’s source code.
obligation_items.object: Bailian service
obligation_items.trigger: At all times when using the service.

coverage_notes: The target paragraph spans Bailian Service Agreement §§4.3.2–7.1. The referenced laws, product documentation, and third-party service agreements are not supplied as local incorporated context; no terms are inferred from them.

Sections 5.1.2–5.1.3, 6.1.3–6.1.6, 6.2.6–6.2.7, and 7.1 include provider-side statements, descriptive scope, or rights and duties that do not create an additional licensee activity rule in the fixed vocabulary. The local licensee duties and restrictions that fit the activity vocabulary are modeled above.

paragraph_audit.reason: Reviewed the complete target span and its surrounding agreement context. Modeled the expressible user duties, conditions, restrictions, and service-use rules; provider-only permissions or commitments and descriptive material do not create additional licensee action rules.
